payload.reason: The evidence indicates that single-language BERT models perform well in specific tasks, suggesting they may outperform multilingual BERT in certain contexts.

claims.text: Single-language BERT models perform better than multilingual BERT in tasks assessing agreement relations, achieving above 80% accuracy.
BERT's performance on syntactic structure tasks is generally higher for single-language models compared to multilingual models, as indicated by the results across various languages.
The base BERT model, which is single-language, has been shown to outperform larger models, suggesting a potential advantage over multilingual BERT.
